messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Summerization Speed Under Unix
parts:
Hi,

this is most likely related to what Ken noticed for the human exon
array where for instance one unit has ~17000 probes(!), cf.

http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/optimization-speed-file-space-ram

The fitting time grows exponentially(?) with the number of
probes/chips. Thus, for such large units alternative
modelling/algorithms have to be found. I do not know of any work that
attacks this problem.

Cheers

Henrik

indices for the units to exclude etc.
